```yaml
name: Extension Publish Marketplace

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        npm run lint:all
        npm run plugin:generate
        npm run spell-check
        npm run lint:md-links
        npm run lint:ps
        npm run validate:skills

    - name: Fix broken file directives and markdown links
      run: |
        find . -type f \( -name "*.md" -o -name "*.ps1" \) -exec sed -i '' 's/#file:../instructions/\n&\/{collection}\/{filename}.md/g' {} +
        find . -type f \( -name "*.md" -o -name "*.ps1" \) -exec sed -i '' 's/\[text\]\(.*\)\(\/instructions\/{filename}\.md\)/\[text\]\1\/{collection}\/{filename}.md/g' {} +

    - name: Verify fixes
      run: |
        find . -type f \( -name "*.md" -o -name "*.ps1" \) -exec grep -q '#file:../../instructions/{collection}/{filename}.md' {} \; || echo "Some fixes may not have been applied correctly."
        find . -type f \( -name "*.md" -o -name "*.ps1" \) -exec grep -q '\[text\]\(.*\)\(\/{collection}\/{filename}.md\)' {} \; || echo "Some fixes may not have been applied correctly."

    - name: Commit changes
      run: |
        git config --global user.name 'GitHub Actions'
        git config --global user.email 'actions@github.com'
        git add .
        git commit -m "fix(instructions): update broken file directives and markdown links after collection directory reorg"
        git push origin main
```
